_about.purpose: Platform delivery specs for scripts/delivery_qc.py. Copy this file into a project and edit it rather than editing the skill.
_about.evidence: Broadcast loudness targets (EBU R128 -23 LUFS, ATSC A/85 -24 LKFS) are published standards. Digital platform targets marked evidence:'unverified' are widely repeated community consensus, NOT vendor documentation — confirm before a contractual delivery.
_about.fields: resolution [w,h] | aspect w/h | fps [allowed] | duration_s [min,max] | video_codec [] | audio_codec [] | sample_rate [] | lufs | lufs_tolerance | true_peak | max_bitrate_mbps | max_size_mb | audio_required | no_silence | notes

youtube-16x9.label: YouTube — standard landscape
youtube-16x9.evidence: unverified — platform normalises loudness on playback; -14 is consensus, not documented

youtube-shorts.label: YouTube Shorts — vertical, 3 min or less
youtube-shorts.notes: Vertical or square at 3 minutes or less is treated as a Short (limit raised from 60s in Oct 2024).

reels-9x16.label: Instagram Reels / Facebook Reels
reels-9x16.evidence: unverified — no published vendor loudness figure found

meta-feed-1x1.label: Meta feed ad — square
meta-feed-1x1.notes: Most feed impressions start muted — the piece must work silent. Verify on-screen text carries the message.

broadcast-ebu-r128.label: Broadcast — EBU R128 (Europe, MENA)
broadcast-ebu-r128.notes: Published standard. Deliverable is usually ProRes or an XDCAM-family master, not H.264 — confirm with the broadcaster.

broadcast-atsc-a85.label: Broadcast — ATSC A/85 (US)
broadcast-atsc-a85.notes: Published standard (LKFS is the same measurement as LUFS).

web-hero-silent.label: Website hero loop — no audio
web-hero-silent.notes: Autoplay requires a muted track or none. Keep it small — this ships on every page load.

dooh-screen.label: Digital out-of-home — silent, no fine print
dooh-screen.notes: Always silent and read at distance. Minimum type size is a physical constraint the verifier cannot judge — check on the real screen size.
